question.text: Since October 2019, all positions in futures and options on individual securities that remain open on expiry date are settled by:

answer.text: Either cash or physical at trader's choice

explanation.text: The Logic: Stock futures and options on individual securities that remain open on the expiry date are physically settled. The Trap: Index F&O continues to be cash-settled; physical settlement here refers specifically to derivatives on individual securities, not all derivatives. Note: Workbook reference: individual-security F&O is physically settled, while index F&O remains cash-settled.
